note: Tattoos of the character creator (Tattoos, the creator's Tattoos row). Our own line art (tools/character/tattoos: SVG -> assets/character/tattoos/tattoo_atlas.png, logged in assets/character/tattoos/SOURCE.md): period sailors' marks, the sky crews' marks of the Drift, plain bands and dots. Everyone may wear any of them from the start (the owner, 2026-10-03). No sacred or people-specific traditions (no Polynesian or Maori designs, no Indigenous North American designs): those wait on consultation (docs/research/peoples_dress_1750s.md 1.3). A design's `place` is where Add puts it first; `places` (bands, dots) are the only places it may go. Places map onto the body's skin through its UVs (Tattoos, tattoo.gdshaderinc): `space` uv (the metre UVs: limbs, hands, neck), front / back (the torso's arc map over the metre UVs) or mh (MakeHuman's UVs: the face, where the metre UVs' cylinder also covers the mouth's and the sockets' inner skin); `anchor` is the place's centre in the metre UVs (u, height) or, with `anchor_face`, in face coordinates (the nearest skin vertex facing `fit_normal`); `side_normal` (hands) keeps the back of the hand and leaves the palm, which shares its planar UVs; build_tattoos.gd measures each place on body.glb into assets/character/tattoos/tattoo_map.json. Sizes in metres (the design's square at scale 1). `view`: how the creator shows the place while it is edited: a close view of its centre carried by `bone` (CreatorStage.focus_skin) at `dist`, the figure turned to show it; `frame` and `yaw` when the bone is missing.

designs.label: Anchor
designs.note: The seaman's commonest mark: an anchor pricked into the forearm, often with his initials.

designs.label: Compass rose
designs.note: A compass rose of eight points, a mark of the navigator.

designs.label: Heart
designs.note: A heart pierced by an arrow, for a sweetheart ashore.

designs.label: Crossed keys
designs.note: Two keys in saltire, the keys of Saint Peter, patron of fishermen.

designs.label: Ship
designs.note: A ship under sail, the vessel a man served in.

designs.label: Initials and year
designs.note: Initials and a year in plain capitals, the commonest mark of all: a name that would identify a drowned man.

designs.label: Crucifix
designs.note: A cross on its Calvary steps; seamen hoped it would earn a Christian burial.

designs.label: Mermaid
designs.note: A mermaid with her looking-glass, a sailors' figure of the sea's luck and danger.

designs.label: Keelstone star
designs.note: Sky crews: the cut keelstone in its star, the stone that floats a ship. Driftfolk wear it for a safe keel.

designs.label: Wind spiral
designs.note: Sky crews: the spiral of a fair wind, pricked on a topman's arm for a following breeze in the Drift.

designs.label: The Drift's waves
designs.note: Sky crews: the curling crests of the upper sea under its stars, the mark of a voyage through the Drift.

designs.label: Plain band
designs.note: A plain band of ink round the limb.

designs.label: Double band
designs.note: Two narrow bands round the limb.

designs.label: Ring of dots
designs.note: A ring of dots round the wrist or the arm.

inks.label: Blue-black
inks.note: Gunpowder or lamp black pricked in with needles: black that shows blue-grey under the skin.

inks.label: Red
inks.note: Vermilion pricked in like the black, rarer and dearer.

inks.label: Faded green
inks.note: An old mark gone green-grey with the years.
